fusions.name: Herald's Charge
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for distance you have travelled (max 40%).

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Rhythm
fusions.desc: Stamps the rod, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gallop to the Fore
fusions.desc: Carries you 6 tiles forward. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Paved Approach
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 10%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
